name: Torus Implicit Function
aliases: Torus Implicit Function — Signed Distance Field (SDF) Torus Primitive
definition: Implicit function for a torus: f(p) = (sqrt(x^2 + y^2) - R)^2 + z^2 - r^2.
summary: The Torus Implicit Function computes the exact signed distance to a torus surface, distinguishing itself by providing analytical precision that avoids the numerical instability of generic quadric approximations.
